definition: floor(3 * 8138082968869 / 2): baseline-only pilot selected 1.5 times the previous reference with final Dice inside 70–77%
accounting: Declared arithmetic per training update, forward/loss/backward/optimizer, dense MAC=2; excludes validation, preprocessing/augmentation, I/O and precision housekeeping
constraint_preset: Original balanced two-step BCE bands, no focal/degree weighting; original pooled edge consistency; scalar weighted sum with one backward
calibration_policy: Charge model/run-specific training-only calibration within B_ref before deriving each arm maximum; 50 Dice prefix updates are part of the trajectory.
signed_distance_policy: Authorized full-volume anterior/posterior SDF boundary loss; clipped at +/-8 model-grid voxels, normalized by 8, no extra prediction head; calibrated after bands and original edge when present.
budget_selection: Exploratory baseline-only final-Dice target band, 70–77%; freeze common cap before six objectives. Constraints did not enter selection.
learning_rate_policy: 5% linear warmup, cosine decay to 1% initial LR over allotted updates; each final objective starts from scratch.
